GenAiPlanner.description: The UI Specialist agent. A generic, presentation-only Agentforce agent whose single job is to render structured data as HXL cards. Other agents (or a human) hand it the data; it decides the best card and builds the action input. Kept as a DEDICATED agent so display logic never pollutes the reasoning of task agents — see README "UI Specialist agent" for the strategy. Today it owns the Ranked Table topic; add one topic per card as the gallery grows.
